follow-up time: From 6-9 months after cesarean delivery to 11-14 weeks of a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: Women aged 18-35 years with one previous cesarean delivery at ≥ 37 weeks.
finding: The appearance of the Cesarean hysterotomy scar and the ability to identify a large scar defect (thickness ≤ 2.5 mm) based on transvaginal ultrasound were similar in the non-pregnant state and at 11-14 weeks in a subsequent pregnancy.
